summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance on node1. All settings remained disabled after a successful node reboot, with networking fully recovered.
actions_performed: Created /etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf for all, default, and per-interface IPv4 settings.
Applied and verified accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0 on all/default/eth0/lo.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified persistence, system health, addressing, routing, and gateway connectivity.

evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
evidence.summary: Shows the initial state, persistent configuration, all runtime values set to 0, and the same values after reboot.
Captures the healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered system/network health with persisted hardening.
